subject: Supplier onboarding: privacy gate & PO routing for Helix Mobile
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@helixmobile.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@helixmobile.com>, procurement@helixmobile.com
Date: 2028-10-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New vendor setup: Redwood Inference — required docs and PO question

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement here at Helix is standing up the vendor record and we hit two quick asks before we can issue a PO: 

1) A signed DPA or link to e-sign (we can route via DocuSign).
2) SOC 2 report access (pdf or secure link) and your current subprocessor inventory CSV.

We've attached our onboarding intake spreadsheet (Helix_Onboarding_Form.xlsx) — please fill the billing contact and remit-to fields so our AP team can map the PO. Also confirm whether Redwood accepts Coupa PO punchouts or if we should send a standard PO to billing@redwood.ai.

Timeline: procurement would like the DPA signed and PO to be issued by 10/31 to hit our Q4 onboarding. Can you confirm next steps and an ownership contact?

Thanks,
Emily Zhao
Senior Procurement Manager
Helix Mobile
emily.zhao@helixmobile.com

---
Attachment: Helix_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (spreadsheet, 36 KB)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@helixmobile.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-27T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup: Redwood Inference — required docs and PO question

Hi Emily — great to hear and thanks for the clear list. Looping in Laura (finance) and Ben (security) to help land items 1–3. Quick answers up front: 

• DPA: we can e-sign. I uploaded our standard DPA (redwood_dpa_v3.2.pdf) to DocuSign and will send the envelope link in this thread; if you need your legal redlines we can accept a tracked change file first.
• SOC 2: our most recent report is hosted on a secure drive link — Ben will paste the access URL.
• Subprocessor inventory: attached as CSV — includes hosting, logging, and telemetry providers.

Billing/PO: we accept both standard PO to billing@redwood.ai and Coupa; if you send a Coupa punchout request Laura will confirm the vendor code. For AP mapping please fill the remit-to and send the completed onboarding spreadsheet back.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben posts secure SOC 2 link + short notes on redactions (if any).
2) I send DocuSign envelope for your signature by EOD today.
3) Laura confirms invoice routing and whether a PO number is required for initial pilot billing.

I appreciate the 10/31 target — we will prioritize.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Sales Ops 
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0193

---
Attachments: redwood_dpa_v3.2.pdf (pdf, 142 KB); subprocessor_inventory_2028-10.csv (csv, 12 KB)

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@helixmobile.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-28T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup: Redwood Inference — SOC 2 link and subprocessor notes

Emily — sharing the SOC 2 access and a few quick notes below.

Access: https://drive.redwood.example.com/soc2/2028/report.html (temporary access link, expires in 30 days). The report includes: scope (inference API hosted in us-west-2), control narratives, and last audit date (2028-06-15).

Redactions: we've redacted customer names and specific IP addresses. If your legal team needs a signed attestation, let me know and we can provide a supplemental letter.

Subprocessor highlights (see attached CSV):
• Cloud hosting: NimbusCloud (us-west-2) — primary inference hosts
• Logging/metrics: Logflux — logs retained 30 days by default (can be customized on Dedicated customers)
• Observability: Traceworks — stores traces for 7 days

Note on data flow: for hosted API usage, customer prompts and generated outputs are processed in-memory on inference nodes and logs are stored per contract options; we can enable stricter retention or disable logging for regulated pilots.

If you'd like a one-pager for your legal team summarizing data flows and retention options I can produce that today.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

---
Attachment: subprocessor_inventory_2028-10.csv (csv, 12 KB)

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@helixmobile.com, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@helixmobile.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-31T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup: Redwood Inference — privacy gate & PO routing for Helix Mobile

Hi Emily — thanks for moving this forward. A few confirmations from Finance/Legal side: 

1) DPA e-sign: you should have received a DocuSign envelope (https://app.docusign.com/envelopes/ABC123def456). Once signed we will countersign and return the executed copy.
2) PO routing: Helix can send a standard PO to billing@redwood.ai. Please include the Helix vendor number (if you have one) in the PO; if you prefer Coupa punchout let us know and I'll share the Redwood vendor code.
3) Initial invoice and pilot: for the pilot phase we accept invoice net 30; if you need a different term we can discuss.

Action items for Helix: 
• Return the filled Helix_Onboarding_Form.xlsx with billing contact by 11/02.
• Sign DPA via DocuSign by 11/02 to hit billing cycle.

Karthik will follow-up on any PO mapping differences; Ben can provide the one-pager data-flow attestation if your legal team requests it.

Laura Bennett
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
